articles.title: After Eight Years in Space, a Telescope Opens Its Eyes
articles.summary: BepiColombo's MIXS telescope passed its first space test, spotting the Crab Nebula more sharply than in lab tests on Earth, just before the mission enters orbit around Mercury.

articles.title: Physicists Find Evidence of a One-in-10-Billion Particle Decay
articles.summary: After more than 40 years of searching, CERN's upgraded LHCb experiment has found evidence of an extremely rare particle decay, a clue that could point to physics beyond the Standard Model.

articles.title: Yosemite Needs Your Help Tracking River Otters
articles.summary: River otters have been spotted in Yosemite National Park, and rangers are asking visitors to report sightings to help track the playful swimmers across the park's 1,700 miles of streams.
